sentences.text: Health visitor Amina Hussain visited the home of Jade Turner to conduct a two-year review for Leo and a check for Poppy.
Leo is two years old and is saying approximately twenty words, including 'mama', 'car', 'more', 'bye-bye', and 'dog'.
Leo sometimes puts two words together, such as 'more juice'.
Leo is mobile, having climbed a bookcase the previous week.
Leo's diet consists of toast, pasta, and yoghurt; he is described as fussy.
Poppy is fed via bottles approximately six times a day and has been started on baby rice.
Poppy has a nappy rash that has been present for about a week and is described as broken in places.
Jade Turner has run out of nappies and has been leaving Poppy on longer than usual.
Jade Turner has limited food supplies at home, including bread, cereal, and one tin of Poppy's milk, with supplies expected to last until Friday.
Jade Turner expressed fear that losing her cleaning job would result in eviction.
Jade Turner has not received any letters or notices from her landlord, though she is concerned rent will not be paid.
Jade Turner receives Universal Credit and described her financial situation as 'tight'.
Jade Turner started a cleaning job at a retail park in September, working night shifts from 10pm to 12am (sometimes half past midnight), earning cash in hand.
Jade Turner's friend Shannon usually looks after Leo and Poppy while Jade works, but this is not always possible.
Jade Turner has left Leo and Poppy alone at home for a couple of hours while she works, stating they are asleep and do not wake up.
Jade Turner leaves Leo and Poppy alone for approximately three nights a week, a situation that has occurred for the last month since Shannon started a new job.
Jade Turner's mother lives in Northby and could help, but they are not currently in contact.
Jade Turner agreed to ask her mother in Northby for help.
Jade Turner has not yet applied for the 15 hours of funded nursery for Leo.
Jade Turner agreed to ensure Leo and Poppy are not left alone on the night if Shannon cannot provide childcare.
Jade Turner agreed to text her supervisor to report she has no childcare available.
Health visitor Amina Hussain will make a referral to children's social care today.
Children's social care is expected to contact Jade Turner by Thursday.
A food bank voucher will be delivered to the home this afternoon before 3pm.
Health visitor Amina Hussain will book Poppy with Dr Lowe for the nappy rash tomorrow.
Health visitor Amina Hussain will bring nappies when she returns to the home.
Health visitor Amina Hussain will return to the home on Monday the 30th at 10am to discuss the nursery form and check on the family.
Jade Turner agreed to the appointment on Monday the 30th at 10am.
